title: Kissed Crispy Greek Lamb Keftedes
description: A romantic Greek dish featuring lamb keftedes with a mustardy and aerated twist, served in agave leaves. This dish is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine lamb mince, creme fraiche, Dijon mustard, garlic, onion, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Remove the bowl from the refrigerator and stir the mixture again.
Spoon the lamb mixture into the center of each agave leaf, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the agave leaves over the filling to form keftedes and secure with toothpicks if needed.
Brush the keftedes with olive oil and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the keftedes in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the keftedes from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
